title: Sandwiching polynomials
statement: For a function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, a natural number $k$, and a real number $\varepsilon$, there are polynomials $P_\ell,P_u:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ of degree at most $k$ such that $P_\ell(x)\le f(x)\le P_u(x)$ for every $x$. Their average pointwise gap under the uniform distribution on $\{0,1\}^n$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
